visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a black Nike zip-up hoodie and a black baseball cap, stands in an outdoor urban square. He speaks directly into his handheld camera with a serious facial expression. The background features prominent red metal architectural beams and lush green palm trees under a bright, overcast sky. (2) The man walks along a paved pathway, passing a large circular restaurant sign with a red background and green Japanese text. He maintains eye contact with the camera while walking. The ground is made of grey stone tiles, and the environment appears to be a commercial shopping district with retail storefronts visible in the distance. (3) The scene cuts to an indoor setting where the man is seated in a black leather office chair. He makes a series of exaggerated facial expressions, including furrowed brows and wide eyes, while speaking. He wears different caps in quick succession, including a blue one with white Taiwan text, while gesturing with his hands. (4) The man is filmed walking across a busy city zebra crossing. In the background, a massive digital billboard displays a smartphone advertisement. Pedestrians and a yellow taxi are visible in the distance. He then transitions to entering a ramen restaurant with traditional red curtains and individual dining stalls partitioned by wood. (5) A close-up shot focuses on a bowl of ramen with a light-colored broth, thin noodles, sliced pork, and green onions. The man uses black chopsticks to lift a large portion of noodles. The lighting is warm and focused on the food. He then proceeds to eat and drink until the bowl is empty, showing the bottom.
